audit_items.proof_trace: The resolved location process_slashings (L1782-1798) only decreases balances for validators already flagged slashed and performs no double-vote detection; the real enforcement is is_slashable_attestation_data (L749-759, 'data_1 != data_2 and same target.epoch') combined with process_attester_slashing (L1985-1998), which sets validator.slashed=True via slash_validator only when a proposer includes a valid AttesterSlashing block operation bundling two BLS-verified conflicting IndexedAttestations. There is no state-resident decidable oracle that automatically scans all cast votes and flags every double-voter; slashing is evidence-based (an external party must observe, construct, and get the AttesterSlashing included on-chain) and slashed can also be set via the unrelated process_proposer_slashing path, so the theorem's iff cannot hold against pyspec's `slashed` field as literally stated.
